landing.headline: Your friends think they know you.
landing.lede: Answer “Have you ever…” questions in private. Guess how many your friends said yes to. Then watch the scores spill.
landing.answerBody: Yes or no questions, alone on your phone. Swipe right for yes, left for no. The host picks how many.
landing.guessBody: Slide a number for each friend. 0 is a saint, 100 is a menace. Close guesses earn Mind Reader points.
landing.spillBody: The host hits reveal. Scores pour in from lowest to highest, then the awards land.
landing.shareBody: Every player gets a card sized for Instagram Stories and WhatsApp Status. Your score, your label, one award. The group card ranks the whole room.

purity.title: How The Purity 100 works
purity.s1p: The Rice Purity Test is a list of 100 yes or no questions. It started at Rice University in the 1920s so students could compare how sheltered they were.
purity.s2p: Questions run from mild to extreme: holding hands and kissing, then sex, then drinking, drugs and breaking rules.
purity.s3p: You tick everything you have done. Your score is 100 minus your ticks, so 100 is completely pure and 0 means you have done it all.
purity.s4p: Your Spill Score counts the yeses instead, so a purity score of 70 is a Spill Score of about 30. Higher means you have done more.
purity.s5p: Your friends guess your score before the reveal. Only the score is shared, unless you turn on Spill Mode.
purity.s6p: Choose All 100 for the full test. 20 or 30 makes a quicker round with questions drawn at random from the pack.

howto.title: How to play
howto.lede: A round takes about 15 minutes. You need {min} or more people and a phone each.
howto.p1: The host taps Start a room, picks a pack and shares the link or the four character code. Everyone else taps Join with code. No account, just a nickname and a face.
howto.p2: The host picks how many “Have you ever…” questions to play. Swipe right for yes, left for no, or use the buttons. Nobody sees your answers unless you switch on Spill Mode at the end.
howto.p3: Your Spill Score runs from 0 to 100. The more you've done, the higher it goes. Slide to guess each friend's score. The closer you land, the more Mind Reader points you earn.
howto.p4: The host starts the reveal. Scores pour in from lowest to highest, labels land, then the awards. Share your card to your Status before the group chat does it for you.
howto.p5: Laugh with people, not at them. If a question isn't right for your group, skip it.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.lede: Short version: only your score is shared. Your answers stay yours.
privacyPage.p1: A nickname, the avatar you pick, your answers and your guesses, all tied to one room. No email, no phone number, no contacts.
privacyPage.p2: Other players see your nickname, avatar, score, label and awards. Your yes and no answers are never shown unless you switch on Spill Mode, and then only to that room.
privacyPage.p3: We only show how many people said yes to a question when 3 or more people answered it, so no single answer points back to you.
privacyPage.p4: Rooms close 24 hours after they open. We keep anonymous counts to improve the packs.

termsPage.title: Terms
termsPage.lede: The rules for using SPIL. Plain English, no traps.
termsPage.p1: Don't use SPIL to bully, out or pressure anyone. Hosts can remove players, and we can close rooms that break these rules.
termsPage.p2: No impersonating real people, no slurs. We filter the obvious ones and you can report the rest.
termsPage.p3: Your card is yours to post. Ask before you post someone else's.
termsPage.p4: Scores are for fun. They say nothing official about anyone.

contactPage.title: Contact
contactPage.lede: Found a bug, a bad question or a better idea? Tell us. To report a question mid game, use the flag on the card.
contactPage.email: Email, if you want a reply
